dashboard.settings.autoAcceptHelp: Orders are confirmed automatically. If the requested time slot is full, the order moves to the next available time slot. It confirms only when there is capacity. Orders with customer notes (e.g. an allergy) still have to be confirmed by you.
dashboard.settings.layoutHelp: How items are shown on the “+ Add an order” screen.
dashboard.settings.layoutTabsHelp: Shows one category at a time. Tap a category to switch. Best for longer menus, where every item stays in the same place.
dashboard.settings.layoutScrollHelp: Shows all items in one scrolling list, with a heading for each category. There are no category buttons — you scroll to move along. Best for shorter menus, where most of it can be seen at once.
dashboard.settings.paidStepHelp: Adds a “Confirm” button when you add an order yourself, so you can send it now and take the payment later.
dashboard.settings.takesCashHelp: Splits the payment button into two: “Cash” and “Card”.
dashboard.settings.orderReadyHelp: Show a “Mark as ready” button on the orders screen. Kitchen screens (KDS) are set up separately. Every time an order is marked ready, the customer is sent an email.
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptTitle: Remind me to add a buzzer
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptHelp: Opens the buzzer grid as soon as you send an order, so the number goes on the board while the customer is still in front of you. Even when this is off you can add a buzzer at any time by tapping the order, but nothing will remind you. Useful where you hand out buzzers; easy to switch off where you do not.
dashboard.settings.cardsHelp: Switch this off when there is a card problem, and customers will order as usual and pay at the food truck instead. Orders keep coming; only the card step stops.
dashboard.settings.cardsScope: This applies to your whole food truck business, on every event, and stays off until you switch it back on.
dashboard.settings.soundsHelp: The on/off switch is on each screen; every device controls its own sound.
